name: antidrift
description: antidrift — single-source-of-truth registry + drift tracking for data entities and design tokens, for AI-assisted development.

plugins.name: antidrift
plugins.description: Describe data entities once in JSON Schema; keep front, back, and agents in sync and flag drift. Optional UI module: design tokens with modes, component specs, generated CSS/Dart token files, hardcoded-color warnings. Commands: list, show, scan, init, tag, import, gen-types, tokens, gen-tokens, ui init.
